name: Yellowstone National Park
description: Famed for its geothermal features and diverse wildlife, this park sits atop a volcanic hot spot featuring dramatic canyons and lush forests.

name: Banff National Park
description: Canada's oldest national park features glacier-fed turquoise lakes, dense coniferous forests, and rugged Rocky Mountain peaks.

name: Serengeti National Park
description: Renowned for its massive annual migration of wildebeests and zebras, the park consists of vast grassland plains and acacia woodlands.

name: Torres del Paine National Park
description: Characterized by soaring granite towers, azure glacial lakes, and sweeping pampas, this park protects vital southern Patagonian ecosystems.

name: Fiordland National Park
description: This dramatic landscape features deeply carved fiords, cascading waterfalls, and ancient temperate rainforests dominated by beech trees.

name: Kruger National Park
description: One of Africa's largest game reserves, it hosts an incredible diversity of wildlife including the Big Five across vast bushveld and riverine forests.

name: Plitvice Lakes National Park
description: Famous for a string of 16 terraced lakes joined by waterfalls, which extend into a limestone canyon surrounded by dense beech and pine forests.

name: Galapagos National Park
description: An isolated volcanic archipelago renowned for its endemic species studied by Charles Darwin, featuring arid scrublands and coastal mangroves.

name: Grand Canyon National Park
description: Home to the immense Grand Canyon, with its bands of red rock revealing millions of years of geological history carved by the Colorado River.

name: Jiuzhaigou Valley
description: A nature reserve and national park known for its multi-tiered waterfalls and colorful lakes nestled within dense deciduous and coniferous forests.

name: Yosemite National Park
description: Celebrated for its towering granite monoliths, ancient giant sequoias, and high waterfalls plunging into deeply glaciated valleys.

name: Komodo National Park
description: Established to protect the endemic Komodo dragon, this rugged island park features dry savannahs and rich coral reef marine habitats.

name: Iguazu National Park
description: Encompassing the majestic Iguazu Falls, this lush subtropical rainforest shelters hundreds of bird species and diverse mammalian fauna.

name: Mount Kilimanjaro National Park
description: Encloses Africa's highest peak, transitioning from cultivated farmlands and dense montane rainforests to barren alpine desert and glacial ice.

name: Sarek National Park
description: A remote wilderness in Swedish Lapland featuring jagged alpine peaks, sweeping glacial valleys, and rushing rivers untouched by roads.

name: Ranthambore National Park
description: A major wildlife sanctuary known for its Bengal tigers, centered around ancient ruins and dry deciduous forests dotted with rocky hills.

name: Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park
description: Protects vast red center desert landscapes, featuring the iconic sandstone monolith of Uluru and the domes of Kata Tjuta.

name: Vatnajökull National Park
description: Dominated by Europe's largest glacier, the park showcases a dramatic interplay of ice caps, active volcanoes, and black sand outwash plains.

name: Jiuzhai Valley National Park
description: Renowned for its multi-tiered waterfalls and colorful lakes nestled in a lush mountain reserve.

name: Chobe National Park
description: Botswana's first national park boasts one of the largest concentrations of game in Africa, particularly massive elephant herds along the Chobe River.

name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
description: Renowned for its plant and animal life, ancient mountains, and remnants of Southern Appalachian mountain culture amidst lush old-growth forests.

name: Cinque Terre National Park
description: A steep coastal landscape featuring terraced vineyards, olive groves, and five colorful cliffside fishing villages overlooking the Ligurian Sea.

name: Glacier National Park
description: A pristine wilderness of glacier-carved peaks and valleys, alpine meadows, and dense coniferous forests spanning the Continental Divide.

name: Aoraki/Mount Cook National Park
description: An alpine park featuring New Zealand's highest peak, permanent ice fields, and massive glaciers within the rugged Southern Alps.

name: Everglades National Park
description: A vast subtropical wilderness of slow-moving freshwater sloughs, sawgrass marshes, and mangrove forests teeming with wading birds and alligators.

name: Table Mountain National Park
description: Encompassing the iconic flat-topped mountain overlooking Cape Town, protecting a remarkably rich and unique fynbos floral kingdom.

name: Zion National Park
description: Characterized by towering cream, pink, and red sandstone cliffs carved by the Virgin River into a dramatic desert canyon landscape.

name: Peneda-Gerês National Park
description: Portugal's sole national park features rugged mountain terrain, ancient oak forests, free-roaming wild horses, and historic stone villages.

name: Kashmir Great Lakes Nature Reserve
description: A high-altitude trekking region featuring pristine glacial lakes nestled beneath snow-dusted Himalayan peaks and alpine meadows.

name: Mount Fuji Shizuoka Forest
description: Surrounding Japan's most famous volcanic peak, this reserve features dense forests, lava tubes, and serene highland lakes.

name: Jiuzhaigou Nature Reserve
description: A protected valley in the Min Mountains famous for its multi-level waterfalls and colorful alpine lakes.

name: Redwood National and State Parks
description: Protects vast old-growth forests of coast redwoods, the tallest living trees on Earth, alongside rugged Pacific coastline.

name: Hoh Rainforest (Olympic National Park)
description: One of the largest temperate rainforests in the U.S., featuring massive sitka spruce, western hemlock, and thick moss-draped canopies.

name: Abisko National Park
description: Located north of the Arctic Circle, this park offers subarctic birch forests, dramatic river canyons, and prime Northern Lights viewing.

name: Bwindi Impenetrable National Park
description: An ancient, dense montane forest that serves as a crucial sanctuary for nearly half of the world's endangered mountain gorillas.

name: Amboseli National Park
description: Renowned for its large elephant herds and iconic views of Mount Kilimanjaro across sprawling acacia savannahs and seasonal swamps.

name: Daintree Rainforest
description: An ancient tropical rainforest containing an immense diversity of flora and fauna, stretching right down to white sandy beaches.

name: Los Glaciares National Park
description: Home to numerous majestic glaciers including the advancing Perito Moreno, fed by the massive Southern Patagonian Ice Field.

name: Tierra del Fuego National Park
description: A subantarctic landscape featuring dramatic mountains, pristine glacial lakes, and peat bogs at the southernmost tip of South America.

name: Canaima National Park
description: A vast wilderness featuring massive table-top mountains called tepuis and Angel Falls, the world's highest uninterrupted waterfall.

name: Manas National Park
description: A UNESCO World Heritage site situated in the foothills of the Himalayas, known for its rare and endangered endemic wildlife.

name: Kaziranga National Park
description: Hosts the world's largest population of the great Indian one-horned rhinoceros amidst tall elephant grass and marshlands.

name: Sundarbans National Park
description: A vast estuarine mangrove forest spread across the Ganges Delta, famous for its elusive Royal Bengal tigers and saltwater crocodiles.

name: Jim Corbett National Park
description: India's oldest national park features riverine belts, hills, grass lands, and a large population of Bengal tigers.

name: Periyar National Park
description: Set high in the Cardamom Hills, this picturesque reserve surrounds a central lake and is famous for its elephants and tigers.

name: Bandhavgarh National Park
description: Known for having one of the highest densities of Bengal tigers in India, set amidst steep ridges and sal forests.

name: Gir National Park
description: The sole home of the endangered Asiatic lion, featuring dry deciduous forests, scrub jungles, and grasslands.

name: Valley of Flowers National Park
description: A high-altitude Himalayan valley renowned for its meadows of endemic alpine flowers and rich diverse fauna.

name: Nanda Devi National Park
description: Surrounding India's second-highest mountain, this remote park is characterized by rugged glacial terrain and high-altitude flora.

name: Silent Valley National Park
description: One of the last untouched tracts of tropical evergreen rainforest in southern India, sheltering rare lion-tailed macaques.

name: Great Himalayan National Park
description: A rugged mountain park featuring alpine pastures, high mountain peaks, and temperate forests harboring diverse Himalayan wildlife.

name: Kanha National Park
description: The inspiration for Rudyard Kipling's Jungle Book, featuring lush sal and bamboo forests, grassy meadows, and swamp deer.

name: Pench National Park
description: Named after the river winding through it, this teak-heavy forest reserve is renowned for its vibrant tiger and leopard populations.

name: Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve
description: Maharashtra's oldest and largest reserve, featuring dense teak forests, marshes, and a thriving population of Bengal tigers.

name: Nagarhole National Park
description: A premier wildlife park featuring rolling hills, streams, and forests that host significant populations of elephants, leopards, and tigers.

name: Bandipur National Park
description: Once a private hunting reserve, it is now a crucial forested sanctuary for Asian elephants and tigers in southern India.

name: Eravikulam National Park
description: High-altitude rolling grasslands famous for being the natural habitat of the endangered Nilgiri tahr and blooming Neelakurinji flowers.

name: Bannerghatta National Park
description: A biological conservation area near Bangalore featuring scrub forests, wildlife rescue centers, and a large safari enclosure.

name: Dudhwa National Park
description: Located on the Indo-Nepal border, this Terai ecosystem protects swamp deer, rhinos, and tigers among dense sal forests.

name: Hemis National Park
description: A high-altitude protected area in the Himalayas renowned as the premier global stronghold for elusive snow leopards.

name: Khangchendzonga National Park
description: Encloses the majestic Mount Khangchendzonga, featuring deep valleys, steep cliffs, ancient glaciers, and rich high-altitude biodiversity.

name: Namdapha National Park
description: A vast and rugged protected area in the eastern Himalayas containing habitats from tropical rainforests to alpine snow.

name: Keoladeo National Park
description: A famous man-made wetland sanctuary that serves as a wintering ground for tens of thousands of migratory waterfowl and birds.

name: Desert National Park
description: An expanse of craggy rocks, ephemeral salt lakes, and shifting sand dunes representing the fragile Thar Desert ecosystem.

name: Sultanpur National Park
description: A prominent wetland bird sanctuary that attracts numerous migratory bird species from Europe, Siberia, and Central Asia.

name: Simlipal National Park
description: A massive elephant and tiger reserve featuring lush green hills, rolling grasslands, and cascading waterfalls.

name: Bhitarkanika National Park
description: A rich mangrove ecosystem intertwined with river deltas, known for its large population of saltwater crocodiles and diverse birdlife.

name: Silent Valley Forest Reserve
description: An undisturbed evergreen forest tract in the Western Ghats protecting endangered primate and plant species.

name: Rajaji National Park
description: Spanning the Shivalik hills, this dense forest is an important elephant and tiger migration corridor along the Ganges.

name: Panna National Park
description: Known for its successful tiger reintroduction program, featuring open grasslands, deep gorges, and the Ken River.

name: Satpura National Park
description: A rugged highland sanctuary featuring sandstone peaks, narrow gorges, dense forests, and rich biodiversity.

name: Madhav National Park
description: A forested plateau featuring lakes, dry deciduous woodlands, and an abundance of antelopes and leopards.

name: Van Vihar National Park
description: An urban national park functioning as a rescue center for wild animals set against the backdrop of upper lake Bhopal.

name: Dachigam National Park
description: Located in the Zabarwan Range, it is celebrated as the last stronghold of the critically endangered hangul deer.

name: Kishtwar National Park
description: A mountainous high-altitude park featuring steep gorges, coniferous forests, and rare alpine fauna like the Himalayan musk deer.

name: Salim Ali National Park
description: A small protected wetland and woodland area in Srinagar named after the renowned ornithologist Salim Ali.

name: Pin Valley National Park
description: A cold desert national park in Spiti Valley, notable for its stark landscapes and endangered snow leopards.

name: Inderkilla National Park
description: A high-altitude forested park in Kullu protecting diverse Himalayan flora, fauna, and pristine ecosystems.

name: Kheerganga National Park
description: High mountain terrain offering lush alpine meadows, hot springs, and rich Himalayan wildlife.

name: Simbalbara National Park
description: A lush sal forest valley sanctuary in the Himalayan foothills supporting goral, sambar, and barking deer.

name: Mukurthi National Park
description: A high-altitude shola-grassland ecosystem in the Nilgiri Hills established to protect the endangered Nilgiri tahr.

name: Guindy National Park
description: A small protected dry evergreen forest located entirely within the city of Chennai, sheltering spotted deer and jackals.

name: Mudumalai National Park
description: A crucial wildlife corridor nestled at the tri-junction of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka, rich in elephants and tigers.

name: Anamalai Tiger Reserve
description: A protected area in the southern Western Ghats featuring undulating hills, dense evergreen forests, and diverse wildlife.

name: Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park
description: Comprises a group of small islands and coral reefs renowned for their rich marine biodiversity and dugongs.

name: Kudremukh National Park
description: A mountain range and national park named after a unique horse-face peak, featuring dense evergreen forests and rolling grasslands.

name: Anshi National Park
description: A dense evergreen and semi-evergreen forest sanctuary in the Western Ghats providing habitat for black panthers and hornbills.

name: Bannerghatta National Sanctuary
description: A protected scrub forest area functioning as an extension of the main biological park.

name: Radhanagari Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A lush forest reserve in the southern Sahyadri hills, famous for being home to Indian bison and diverse birdlife.

name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park
description: A large protected forest area located on the northern edge of Mumbai, sheltering ancient rock-cut caves and leopards.

name: Tansa Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Surrounding the Tansa lake reservoir, this sanctuary consists of moist deciduous forests rich in avian fauna.

name: Kalsubai Harishchandragad Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Encompassing the highest peaks in Maharashtra, this rugged sanctuary features dry deciduous forests and deep valleys.

name: Melghat Tiger Reserve
description: Situated on the southern spur of the Satpura hill range, this rugged dry deciduous forest is a vital tiger habitat.

name: Navegaon National Park
description: Centered around a large picturesque lake, this forest reserve is a haven for migratory waterbirds and resident fauna.

name: Pench National Park (Maharashtra)
description: The Maharashtra portion of the Pench tiger reserve, featuring teak forests and rolling hills.

name: Sahyadri Tiger Reserve
description: Spanning the crest of the Sahyadri mountain range, this reserve protects evergreen forests and plateau grasslands.

name: Phansad Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A coastal woodland sanctuary featuring rich semi-evergreen and moist deciduous forests along the Konkan coast.

name: Karnala Bird Sanctuary
description: A compact forest sanctuary built around the historic Karnala fort, famous for its resident and migratory bird species.

name: Bhimashankar Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A dense forest reserve in the Western Ghats known for protecting the endangered giant Indian squirrel.

name: Gautam Buddha Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A forested sanctuary situated in a hilly tract, known for supporting leopards, sloth bears, and various deer species.

name: Valmiki National Park
description: Located at the northernmost corner of Bihar, this dense forest ecosystem is a continuation of the Himalayan Terai.

name: Buxa Tiger Reserve
description: Located in the Buxa hills of the southern Himalayan foothills, this forest reserve harbors diverse mammalian species.

name: Gorumara National Park
description: A medium-sized park in the Dooars region famous for its grasslands and populations of Indian rhinoceros.

name: Jaldapara National Park
description: Situated on the banks of the Torsa River, this park features riverine forests and vast tall grass meadows.

name: Neora Valley National Park
description: An unspoiled pristine wilderness in the Kalimpong hills, featuring dense bamboo groves and temperate rhododendron forests.

name: Singalila National Park
description: High-altitude ridge park along the Singalila ridge offering breathtaking views of the Himalayan giants and red pandas.

name: Betla National Park
description: A rich forested sanctuary featuring dense sal and bamboo woods, waterfalls, and historical fort ruins.

name: Hazaribagh National Park
description: A picturesque hilly wildlife sanctuary set within low plateaus covered by tropical dry deciduous forests.

name: Dalma Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A hilly forest sanctuary encircling the Dalma hills, known for its significant wild elephant population.

name: Koderma Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A forested tract in the Damodar valley known for its undulating topography and rich dry deciduous woods.

name: Chandaka Elephant Sanctuary
description: A protected forest area near Bhubaneswar serving as a safe haven for wild Asian elephants.

name: Nandankanan Zoological Park
description: A premier zoo and botanical sanctuary built around a natural lake, famous for its white tigers and breeding programs.

name: Satkosia Tiger Reserve
description: Centered around a magnificent gorge carved by the Mahanadi River through the Eastern Ghats.

name: Sunken Forest of Lake Kaindy
description: A mountain lake featuring the eerie, submerged trunks of dead Tien Shan spruce trees piercing the turquoise surface.

name: Charyn Canyon National Park
description: Features immense, wind-sculpted red sandstone cliffs and deep chasms reminiscent of the Grand Canyon.

name: Kulsar Nature Reserve
description: A semi-desert and desert reserve in western Kazakhstan safeguarding arid steppe ecosystems and endemic fauna.

name: Aksu-Zhabagly Nature Reserve
description: The oldest nature reserve in Central Asia, protecting western Tien Shan alpine meadows, glaciers, and snow leopards.

name: Korgalzhyn Nature Reserve
description: A vast wetland and lake system in the Kazakh steppe providing a critical breeding ground for millions of waterbirds including flamingos.

name: Altyn-Emel National Park
description: Encompasses desert plains, ancient burial mounds, and the famous 'Singing Barchan' sand dune.

name: Burabay National Park
description: Often called the 'Switzerland of Kazakhstan', this forested oasis features pine woods, granite rocks, and scenic lakes.
